en: A vintage black-and-white panoramic view of a small Alpine town set in a wide valley at the foot of a large mountain. The settlement consists of clustered traditional buildings, with a prominent church and steeple on the right side. Open fields and scattered trees occupy the foreground, while rugged, forested slopes rise steeply behind the town. Text printed at the top reads the location and altitude.
